# Harry Yu

> Software engineer and Brandeis CS graduate working across systems, machine learning, game development, and interactive 3D. From real-time 3D pose-estimation research at Peking University to Dockerized monitoring stacks, Godot games, and patented hardware design.

Harry builds across the full spectrum — backend systems and data pipelines, ML research, game development, and hardware — with a focus on turning ambiguous problems into shipped, dependable things. The portfolio at harryyu.dev is an interactive 3D (WebGL) experience; the complete text content is mirrored in the files linked below for language models.

## Experience
- Research Assistant, Peking University HOME Lab (Jun 2025–Dec 2025): Real-time 3D human pose estimation from sparse sensors; calibration, keypoint integration, and validation methods tracing joint stability and latency.
- Software Engineer Intern, REON Technology Inc. (Jun 2023–Jan 2024): Data-validation layer and Dockerized monitoring stack for BMS battery experiments; decision-ready Jupyter dashboards.
- Channel Operator, DIY Perks authorized Bilibili channel (Nov 2020–Present): Led a 7-member localization team; 160+ videos, 250M views, 1M+ followers; Python+Excel payout automation.
- Teaching Assistant, Brandeis COSI 150A Compiler Design (Jan 2024–May 2024).

## Selected projects
- Companion Cube: On-device ADHD focus-state classifier (76.8% accuracy) with privacy-first SQLite architecture.
- ADHD Simulator: Godot empathy game translating symptoms into mechanics; Blender environments, behavior-tree AI, 500+ downloads in week one.
- Real-Time 3D Pose Estimation: Sparse-sensor motion reconstruction research at Peking University.
- All-in-One Keyboard: Design Patent CN306847318S — a laptop-motherboard computer beneath an ergonomic mechanical keyboard.
- Farm Traceability Cam: DeisHacks 2023 Best Marketing — crop time-lapse videos linked to scannable QR codes.
